name: Dominaria
description: Dominaria is a plane of varied terrain and countless historic locations, birthplace of Urza and Mishra and home plane of Liliana, Jaya Ballard and Venser.

summary.text: Dominaria is a plane of varied terrain and countless historic locations, birthplace of Urza and Mishra and home plane of Liliana, Jaya Ballard and Venser.

bio.text: Urza and Mishra wage a savage war on each other that devastates Dominaria and plunges it into an ice age.

The Weatherlight and its crew thwart Phyrexia's near invasion, and later cataclysms, many caused by planeswalkers, leave the plane desolated and destabilize the Multiverse until powerful planeswalkers mend the rifts.
After generations of peace much of Dominaria rebuilds its past cultures, while the Cabal grows stronger under the Demonlord Belzenlok.
Gideon arrives wounded with Liliana, Chandra and Nissa, and Jace lands on the plane to meet his friends.
Later, the Phyrexians threaten Dominaria and a Coalition defends it, with the Mana Rig in Shiv and Liliana's family estate among its locations.

status.text: Dominaria is a rebuilt plane that, as of the latest material, the Coalition is defending against Phyrexian invasion.

timeline.summary: Jace says he must meet his friends on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: I need to meet my friends on Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Jace planeswalks and lands aboard a fast-moving vessel on Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Jace stepped through the aether forcefully and immediately caught himself on a wall.

timeline.summary: Gideon is overjoyed to see Jace alive.
timeline.quote: Gideon! I'm not dead!

timeline.summary: An older woman in red robes blocks Gideon and asks who Jace is.
timeline.quote: Who's the bookworm?

timeline.summary: Gideon arrives on Dominaria wounded after Amonkhet, with Liliana, Chandra and Nissa.
timeline.quote: Dominaria coalesced around Gideon and the first thing that struck him was the stench of rotting plants and dank earth.

timeline.summary: Chandra confronts Jaya, who has revealed she was posing as Mother Luti, and Jaya explains she went back to Regatha to find a religion built on her and guided it.
timeline.quote: Two hundred years later, I went back and found they'd started a religion based on me.

timeline.summary: Chandra offers Jaya her goggles and asks for the secret to being a more powerful pyromancer, and Jaya flatly refuses.
timeline.quote: Jaya took the goggles, and her expression turned hard as stone. "Absolutely not."

timeline.summary: The next morning Karn tells Chandra that the automatons are digging for the Sylex, which Urza created, and that he means to detonate it on New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: It was created by Urza to help defeat the Phyrexians. I intend to take it to New Phyrexia and detonate it there.

timeline.summary: Chandra tries again to change Jaya's mind, and Jaya says there is no secret and that Chandra does not know what she wants.
timeline.quote: There's no secret. To master your power, you need to know what you want, know your true self.

timeline.summary: Karn uncovers the Sylex beneath a broken slab in the pit.
timeline.quote: "He's found the Sylex." Jaya let her breath out, but she didn't look relieved.

timeline.summary: Animate trees swarm the crater to reach the Sylex, and Chandra and Jaya fight them off with fire.
timeline.quote: They were desperate to get to Karn and the Sylex.

timeline.summary: Multani rises as a giant of roots and branches, and Karn says he is still semiconscious.
timeline.quote: He's still semiconscious. He would never hurt us if he were himself.

timeline.summary: Teferi freezes Multani and the trees with time magic from the Weatherlight.
timeline.quote: "It's time magic."

timeline.summary: Chandra recognizes Gideon and Liliana aboard the Weatherlight as they call the group to come aboard.
timeline.quote: "Gideon!" She waved wildly.

timeline.summary: Chandra uses Nissa's visualization to calm Multani, who regains awareness and recovers.
timeline.quote: The angry gold light from his eyes and mouth faded to a deep blue, and she was sure she saw awareness there.

timeline.summary: Karn promises Multani he will take the Sylex to New Phyrexia and never harm Dominaria.
timeline.quote: It will never harm Dominaria, I swear it.

timeline.summary: Chandra apologizes to Jaya for how she treated her, and Jaya says Chandra has potential and invites her aboard.
timeline.quote: what you did with Multani shows me you have potential.

timeline.summary: Teferi greets Karn aboard the Weatherlight, and Jhoira says Ajani told her of Venser's sacrifice.
timeline.quote: Ajani Goldmane came to tell me. Teferi knows, too.

timeline.summary: Jhoira shows Teferi the Powerstone locket holding his spark and asks him to take it back, so he can help kill Bolas.
timeline.quote: "The Mana Rig." She held it out to him. "Will you take it back?"

timeline.summary: On the new plane Jace tells the others that Liliana never intended to come and used them, but Gideon insists she has changed.
timeline.quote: She used you, just like she uses everyone.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin shifts back to Dominaria and finds the birth mountain now holds a city and temple with curved horns, which tells him Nicol rules there.
timeline.quote: He recognizes the shape of the curved horns.

timeline.summary: In the vision, Ugin confronts Nicol atop the birth mountain about his mind-manipulation and the pointlessness of his conquests.
timeline.quote: You tried to influence me with that trick of the mind.

timeline.summary: Ugin reveals he is a planeswalker, and Nicol asks to be taught.
timeline.quote: I am a Planeswalker now.

timeline.summary: Ugin cannot explain the spark; Nicol calls him a liar and a coward, and Ugin leaves in fury and grief.
timeline.quote: You can't tell me, can you?

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he alone dared to land on the ground and named the world Dominaria.
timeline.quote: So, I named our home Dominaria, because I claimed its song for myself.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he avenged his sister's death on the humans while Ugin lost his nerve, then Ugin fled, vanishing.
timeline.quote: And so, he fled. He vanished, there one moment and then as if with the blink of the eye and a ripple through the air . . . GONE.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he killed the sorcerers around him and founded academies, then fought wars with his siblings until Arcades retreated and Ugin returned in the middle of the final battle.
timeline.quote: One day, when I had finally driven that stubborn tyrant Arcades into retreat, Ugin returned.

timeline.summary: Bolas says Ugin mocked him atop the birth mountain and vanished, and Bolas felt rage and envy.
timeline.quote: In a ripple of warm wind, he was gone.

timeline.summary: Bolas claims he visited hundreds of worlds, found no other planeswalker, and returned home to share this with Ugin.
timeline.quote: I was the first among all sapient creatures to discover the possibility of traveling between planes.

timeline.summary: Bolas visits Arcades's kingdom, hears he last saw Ugin long ago, and plants doubts in his mind about his subjects.
timeline.quote: I insinuated a worm of doubt in his haughty mind

timeline.summary: In the memory, Elspeth tells Ajani how she tricked Heliod into a second confrontation, letting Erebos imprison him.
timeline.quote: she gave Erebos, God of the Dead, an opportunity to imprison Heliod.

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Elspeth that home is a feeling, not a place; she bristles and walks away.
timeline.quote: "Elspeth, home is not a place; it is a feeling.

timeline.summary: In the memory, Ajani reveals he found her home, New Capenna, and asks her to learn how it survived a past Phyrexian incursion.
timeline.quote: "There are rumors of a past incursion there, and since New Capenna is still standing, that means they defeated the previous threat."

timeline.summary: Elspeth planeswalks to New Capenna after Ajani's farewell.
timeline.quote: She didn't look back as she planeswalked away, headed for what she hoped was home.

timeline.summary: R invites Huatli to meet on Dominaria; Huatli agrees, and R later proposes a drink.
timeline.quote: Want to meet up for a drink?

timeline.summary: Karn arrives in a Phyrexian cavern and is welcomed by Elesh Norn, who calls him Father.
timeline.quote: Welcome, Father.

timeline.summary: Elesh Norn shows the helpless Karn a small oil-beaded sapling and calls it the beginning of everything.
timeline.quote: It is the beginning of great things, Father.

timeline.summary: Teferi wakes whole on a beach, cut off from Kaya and the Anchor, and starts to walk inland.
timeline.quote: He was no longer a spirit.

timeline.summary: Chandra walks into the marsh and weeps, afraid to planeswalk alone to New Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: Going to New Phyrexia is the right thing to do.

timeline.summary: Wrenn joins Chandra, saying the World Tree is alive and that she can reach Teferi with Chandra's fire and the World Tree's power.
timeline.quote: The others were wrong—that tree is alive.

timeline.summary: Chandra, Wrenn and Seven leave to head for New Phyrexia while unseen watchers observe them.
timeline.quote: Let's head out.

timeline.summary: Unseen watchers declare they are there to witness the beginning of the end.
timeline.quote: We are here to witness the beginning of the end.

timeline.summary: Lyra receives an honorary knighthood from Danitha Capashen to further ties between the Serrans and Benalia.
timeline.quote: Lyra received an honorary knighthood from Danitha Capashen meant to further the ties between the Serrans and Benalia.

timeline.summary: Muldrotha calls on Multani to fuse with Yargle to defend Urborg against the Phyrexians.
timeline.quote: it was Muldrotha who called upon her father, Multani, to fuse with Yargle and aid in its defense of Urborg.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra wage a savage war on each other, devastating Dominaria and plunging it into an ice age.
timeline.quote: the brothers waged a savage war against each other, devastating Dominaria and plunging the plane into an ice age.

timeline.summary: The Weatherlight and its crew, with the Legacy including Karn, thwart Phyrexia's near invasion of Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Phyrexia nearly invaded Dominaria, were it not for the skyship Weatherlight and its crew.

timeline.summary: Cataclysms, many caused by planeswalkers, leave Dominaria desolated and destabilize the Multiverse; powerful planeswalkers intervene to mend the rifts.
timeline.quote: A handful of powerful Planeswalkers intervened to mend the rifts, thus restabilizing all the planes.

timeline.summary: After generations of peace, much of Dominaria rebuilds its past cultures.
timeline.quote: Today, after generations of peaceful development, much of Dominaria has managed to rebuild the cultures of its past.

timeline.summary: The Cabal grows in strength under the Demonlord Belzenlok, posing new threats to Dominaria.
timeline.quote: as the cult of the Cabal grows in strength, now under the control of the Demonlord Belzenlok, Dominaria faces new threats

timeline.summary: Freyalise sacrifices her life to save her people, preventing a catastrophe that threatened to destroy Dominaria.
timeline.quote: She heroically sacrificed her life to save her people and prevented a catastrophe that threatened to destroy Dominaria.

timeline.summary: Jaya, born on Dominaria over 1,500 years ago, plays an important part in its early history before disappearing for centuries.
timeline.quote: Born on Dominaria more than 1,500 years ago, she was a hot-headed, sarcastic hero

timeline.summary: Urza, obsessed with Dominaria's history and the Thran Empire, begins a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and Phyrexia.
timeline.quote: This led to a millennia-long vendetta against Yawgmoth and the plane of Phyrexia.

timeline.summary: Venser's talent ignites his spark, making him a planeswalker with access to the planes beyond Dominaria.
timeline.quote: Venser’s talent eventually ignited his spark, making him a Planeswalker
